AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

2. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

3. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

4. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

5. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

7. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

11. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.

12. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

13. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

14. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

15. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Cargo Handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
